2117618397156647178.en_summary: Scott Redler (@RedDogT3) is not buying the dip, citing serious market weakness ahead of the election with the broader market only about 4% off highs, insufficient for his "blood in the streets" strategy which activates at 5–7% below highs. $SPY gave a classic Red Dog Reversal sell signal after failing to hold higher and selling off, with $750/$749 critical and support at the 200-day MA. $QQQ is leading lower, testing its 200-day EMA after ATHs a month ago, with a close below $683.45 a warning. $AAPL is approaching its 100-day MA around $323/$321, with possible tactical buy after establishing a low but not catching a falling knife. Staying away from $PLTR after breaking its wedge pattern post failed breakout, with $163 an important reference and 200-day MA in focus. $TSLA shows relative strength; bought on reclaim of $387 as a swing with stop at $387 (or $397 low for active traders), and if it holds through election could outperform. Not chasing $NVDA/semis bounce after another push-through failure and close near lows; prefers selling into strength with 200-day MA and $205 area in focus. $SNDK remains broken below 200-day, $MU beginning to weaken. Many broken charts including $NBIS and $ASTS after false breakouts and breakdowns below 8/21-day MAs. Not every dip is a buying opportunity; control risk amid election uncertainty.
2117618397156647178.zh_summary: Scott Redler (@RedDogT3) 不買入回調，認為市場在選舉前顯示嚴重弱勢跡象，整體市場僅較高點回落約4%，不足以啟動其「血洗街頭」策略（通常在較高點回落5–7%時啟動）。$SPY 給出經典Red Dog反轉賣出信號，嘗試突破失敗後全天賣出，$750/$749區域關鍵，下方支撐至200日均線。$QQQ 領先下行，一個月前曾創新高，現測試200日EMA，收盤低於$683.45為警示。$AAPL 接近100日均線約$323/$321，或有戰術性買入機會，但須等確立低點後再考慮，勿盲目接飛刀。遠離$PLTR，因突破失敗後突破楔形形態，技術損傷顯著，$163為重要參考，200日均線亦受關注。$TSLA 顯示相對強勢，在重新收復$387時買入作為波段，止損$387（主動交易者可用昨日$397低點），若能撐過選舉或維持相對跑贏。不追逐$NVDA/半導體反彈，昨日再次推升失敗並收近低點，寧願在強勢時賣出，關注200日均線及$205區域。$SNDK 仍技術性跌破200日均線，$MU 開始顯弱。許多圖表已破，包括$NBIS及$ASTS等前市場領導股，因假突破及跌破8/21日均線。並非每個回調都是買入機會，在選舉不確定性下控制風險。

ticker_notes.AAPL: 接近100日均線約$323，或有戰術機會
ticker_notes.NVDA: 賣出強勢，關注$205及200日均線
